title: A/P: an overpaid bill is still listed with a negative balance
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has a $100.00 bill that was paid $110.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Open every bucket.
  4. Find vendor Y's bill.
  5. Read its Open Balance.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • the bill is listed.

Step 5:

  • Open Balance $-10.00.

Why this matters: An overpayment to a vendor is money the shop is owed back.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingDetailFetcher.php:97; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApAgingDetailFetcher.php:164. V1 code, quoted: `->andWhere('vt.balance <> 0')`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-039) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.

AUTOMATION: READY
